name: Brikpanel – Admin Panel Dashboard for WooCommerce
author: Brksoft

sections.description:
Brikpanel transforms the default WooCommerce admin into a cleaner, faster, and more intuitive dashboard.

Built for store owners who want better control over their store’s performance, Brikpanel improves how you manage orders, track live metrics, and get work done faster – all inside your WordPress admin.

🚀 Free Version Includes:
– Clean and fast WooCommerce dashboard
– Modern sidebar and layout
– Mobile-friendly interface
– Quick order search with keyboard shortcut
– Visual redesign of core admin pages

⚡️ Pro Features (Upgrade at brksoft.com):
– 🛍️ Conversion Journey – See how users behave before purchase
– 👀 Most Viewed Pages – Know which pages attract the most attention
– 🛒 Most Added to Cart Products – Identify top carted items
– 📊 Live Visitors – Real-time traffic insight
– 💰 Best Selling Products – View your top earners at a glance

🔐 Pro features are visible but locked in the free version. Clicking will guide users to the upgrade page.

Upgrade to Brikpanel Pro

Unlock advanced analytics, real-time visitor data, and revenue-driving insights.

🔥 Upgrade Now: https://brksoft.com/brikpanel/
sections.installation:
1. Download from WordPress.org or upload the zip file.
  2. Install via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate via the Plugins screen.
  4. Visit your WooCommerce dashboard – Brikpanel will be ready!
sections.faq:
What does Brikpanel do?

It replaces the standard WooCommerce admin interface with a faster, more intuitive dashboard experience.

Is Brikpanel free?

Yes! You can use the redesigned admin panel and order tools for free. Advanced metrics are available in the Pro version.

How do I unlock Pro features?

Upgrade anytime via https://brksoft.com/brikpanel/ to unlock all real-time analytics and conversion tracking tools.

Does it affect site performance?

No. Brikpanel runs entirely in the admin panel and is optimized for speed.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Absolutely. All pages are responsive and optimized for touch use.
